title: Screen-lit laptop in three slow moves
summary: A dark laptop on pure black, lit only by its own interface, filmed in three equal 5.2 s shots: a low truck across the screen, a push-in on the chart, a pull-out to the whole device. Darkness and foreground keyboard blur sell the macro lens.
use_when: A premium, quiet product teaser for a desktop or web app with one strong dashboard screen
A silent autoplay loop or hero background where nothing should flash or cut fast
The UI has a chart or progress panel worth a close detail shot
Opening or closing a longer film on the product in its device

look.type_style: the only type is the product UI on the screen: small sans UI labels, one bold project title; no overlay copy

structure.shot: low three-quarter angle on the left half of a dark laptop screen (project page), keyboard deck blurred in the foreground
structure.camera: dolly: truck right, pan -1.5 px/fr at 1920 (-45 px/s), scale 1.000 -> 1.016 (+0.3 %/s) over 156 fr, easings.linear; elevation ~5-10 deg, yaw ~35-40 deg
structure.motion: no element motion; screen UI static; keyboard deck blurred ~12-20 px at 1920, far screen corner ~3-4 px; first frame already at full exposure (no fade)

structure.shot: close detail of the progress chart panel on the right of the screen, keys as large bokeh in the lower left
structure.camera: push-in 1.00 -> 1.10 (+1.8 %/s) over 156 fr, pan +0.5 px/fr, easings.linear
structure.motion: no element motion; chart already drawn; keyboard foreground almost no detail (heavy blur)

structure.shot: front view of the whole laptop, full project overview screen centred, soft keyboard below, black around
structure.camera: pull-out 1.000 -> 0.874 (-2.6 %/s) over 156 fr, no pan, easings.linear
structure.motion: no element motion; keyboard stays soft in front of a sharp screen; film ends on the held wide frame

params.brand: any brand.json: bg (near black), accent for the chart, UI font
params.content.screen: one product screen authored at 1512x982 with a chart or progress panel in its right third
params.content.detailRect: screen region the push-in shot frames (the chart panel)
params.timing.shot: frames per shot at 30 fps (default 156 = 5.2 s), three equal shots

notes: Measured by hand frame by frame and confirmed on the sheets: three shots of exactly 156 fr, cuts at 5.20 and 10.40 s (cuts.json missed both: scdet near-misses 6.6 and 6.4 because the frames are so dark). All moves linear, uniform, very slow (0.3-2.6 %/s). Background luma 0-3; body lit only by screen spill on edges and key caps. Keyboard foreground blur is depth of field without a rack. The catalogue hint says orbit, but the camera never circles: each shot is a new fixed angle with one linear move (proposed term screen-lit, see recipe.md). Silent: sfx planned by the glue rule would be none, not measured.
